Package frc.robot.subsystems

Class TurretSubsystem

java.lang.Object
edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.SubsystemBase
frc.robot.subsystems.TurretSubsystem
All Implemented Interfaces:
edu.wpi.first.util.sendable.Sendable, edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.Subsystem
public class TurretSubsystem extends edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.SubsystemBase
A subsystem that allows control of the flywheel, the hood, the turret's angle, and the kicker.
